contract.cli: check-table-support.py --entry FILE --evidence DIR [--evidence DIR ...] [--root DIR] [--json] ; check-table-support.py --selftest --work DIR
contract.scope: a markdown table (header row, separator row, data rows) whose caption — the contiguous non-blank, non-heading, non-table paragraph immediately above the header — matches /\brecorded cases?\b/i
contract.binding: the contiguous non-blank, non-heading, non-table paragraph immediately below the last data row; each line of it binds every row one of whose label tokens (first cell, *_` stripped, NFKD-folded lowercase [a-z]+ tokens of length >= 3, not in STOP, not 'and') equals a token of the line; a line's support is the capture <evidence>/<S-id>.txt (first evidence dir holding it) for each S\d{3,} it carries plus each backticked `path.md:a[-b]` it carries, read from <root>/corpus/knowledge/<path> lines a..b
contract.support_rule: content words of a non-label cell: NFKD-fold, drop combining marks, lowercase, [a-z]+ tokens of length >= 4 not in STOP (the set in reports/round-100/controls/feasibility/table_support_ref.py), deduplicated; stems by the ref's stem() (ies->y; es after s/x/z/ch/sh; trailing s not ss); best = max over single support texts of the number of distinct cell stems inside any 80 consecutive tokens; the cell is supported iff best*4 >= total*3
contract.findings: UNSUPPORTED-CELL {row, col (header cell text), words (folded cell words whose stem occurs in none of the row's support texts, sorted), best, total}; UNBOUND-ROW {row} when no binding line binds the row or none of those lines carries an S-id or path; NO-CAPTURE {sid} once per table; NO-PATH {path}; each with line
contract.output: --json: one JSON object {findings: [...], scoped_tables: int}; text mode: one FINDING line each and the summary `TABLE-SUPPORT: <n> finding(s) in <t> scoped table(s)`; rc 1 when findings, 0 when none; rc 2 with a TABLE_SUPPORT_ERROR line and no traceback on a missing or non-UTF-8 entry, a missing evidence dir or no --evidence
